desk:
**BLUF:**  
The OSINT community is focused on Iranian attacks sinking commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, with two ships hit in the past day. The single most important development is the confirmed sinking of the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride, marking the fourth such loss since the war began. Secondary threads cover Starlink throttling for Ukrainian forces and a U.S. Navy F-35C milestone.

## MAIN THREADS
### Strait of Hormuz attacks
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110318589320351814) and [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2110416723967086733) report two container ships targeted yesterday; GFS Pride sank after evacuation, with imagery of the oil slick and debris.
- [@UK_MTO](https://x.com/UK_MTO/status/2110315543110541500) and [@UK_MTO](https://x.com/UK_MTO/status/2110314165013492051) issued formal warnings 172-26 and 173-26 on the incidents.
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2110416730162135292) and [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110318710653423623) note this follows the earlier sinking of CAPE DAO and reflects Iran’s rising tempo amid stalled talks and U.S. blockades.

### Starlink restrictions on Ukraine
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110341286049784195) details new speed limits (~110-160 km/h) on StarShield terminals disrupting drone missions, with no prior warning; multiple Ukrainian officials cited.
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2110283529523192313) links the throttling to broader U.S. policy shifts under the Trump administration.

### U.S. Navy carrier testing
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110373736926818767) reports the first F-35C arrested landing on USS John F. Kennedy (CVN-79) during compatibility trials.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110341286049784195) (unconfirmed): Starlink speed limits began overnight and forced cancellation of some Ukrainian missions.  
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2110416730162135292) (unconfirmed): CAPE DAO finally sank after foundering nearly a month.  
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110318710653423623) (unconfirmed): Iran has now sunk four commercial vessels since the war started.

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are tracking further Iranian strikes on Hormuz traffic and any U.S. response. They are also monitoring whether Starlink limits expand or ease and the next phase of Kennedy carrier trials.
